description: Validates scenario template provenance, orientation standing, drift, migration lag, and inherited template debt through template-manager.

levels.name: Template provenance absent
levels.description: The scenario has no trustworthy record of the template lineage that produced or adopted it.
entry_criteria: A scenario root exists and can be inspected.
exit_criteria: The scenario declares generation.template.id and generation.template.version in .vrooli/service.json.
levels.next_unlock: Stamp adopted provenance for the latest default template.

levels.name: Template lineage known
levels.description: The scenario has a readable template provenance block.
entry_criteria: Template provenance identifies a known template and version.
exit_criteria: Orientation state is available or the scenario is finalized.

levels.name: Orientation standing known
levels.description: Template orientation standing can be evaluated without running deep validation.
entry_criteria: Orientation state is readable when the scenario is not finalized.
exit_criteria: Template version and manifest hashes are current enough to bound drift and migration lag.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve version lag and static drift evidence.

levels.name: Template standing current
levels.description: The scenario is at the current template version with bounded static drift.
entry_criteria: Template version lag and static manifest drift are absent.
exit_criteria: Inherited template debt is resolved or intentionally accepted.

levels.name: Template standing clean
levels.description: The scenario carries current provenance, honest orientation state, bounded drift, and no inherited template debt.
entry_criteria: All lower rungs are satisfied and inherited template debt is clean.
exit_criteria: Template standing remains clean after new template releases.
levels.capability_summary: Template standing is self-describing and ready for fleet governance.

capabilities.label: Generation Provenance
capabilities.description: Template identity, version, and adoption metadata are present.

levels.name: Template provenance absent
levels.description: No generation provenance is available.
exit_criteria: generation.template.id and generation.template.version are present.

levels.name: Template lineage known
levels.description: Template id and version are readable.
exit_criteria: The template id resolves to the registry.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve the template id against the registry.

levels.name: Template lineage registered
levels.description: The template id is known to template-manager.
exit_criteria: Version lag can be evaluated.

levels.name: Template provenance current
levels.description: The provenance record is current enough for governance.
exit_criteria: No provenance findings remain.

levels.name: Template provenance clean
levels.description: Template provenance is complete and trusted.
exit_criteria: Continue preserving provenance on future migrations.
levels.capability_summary: Generation provenance is clean and reusable.

capabilities.label: Orientation Standing
capabilities.description: Generated initialization gates are visible and machine-readable.

levels.name: Orientation target unavailable
levels.description: The scenario cannot be inspected for orientation standing.
exit_criteria: Template provenance is available.

levels.name: Orientation state missing
levels.description: Orientation standing is not available as machine-readable state.
exit_criteria: Orientation state is available or the scenario is finalized.

levels.name: Orientation state readable
levels.description: Orientation standing can be read without deep validation.
exit_criteria: Required gates have explicit standing.

levels.name: Orientation standing current
levels.description: Required orientation gates are visible and current.
exit_criteria: No orientation findings remain.

levels.name: Orientation standing clean
levels.description: Orientation is an honest work-order feed.
exit_criteria: Keep gate definitions current as templates evolve.
levels.capability_summary: Orientation standing is machine-readable and clean.

capabilities.label: Drift and Migration
capabilities.description: Template version lag and static drift are bounded.

levels.name: Drift target unavailable
levels.description: Drift cannot be assessed because provenance is missing.
exit_criteria: Template provenance is available.

levels.name: Drift baseline known
levels.description: A template baseline is known.
entry_criteria: Template id and version are known.
exit_criteria: Current template version can be compared.
levels.next_unlock: Compare against the registry and changelog.

levels.name: Migration lag known
levels.description: Template version lag can be evaluated.
exit_criteria: The scenario is at the latest registered version.

levels.name: Static drift bounded
levels.description: Version lag and static manifest drift are bounded.
entry_criteria: The scenario is at the latest template version.
exit_criteria: No drift or migration findings remain.

levels.name: Drift and migration clean
levels.description: Template drift and migration lag are clean.
entry_criteria: No drift or migration findings remain.
exit_criteria: Keep changelog migrations applied after releases.
levels.capability_summary: Drift and migration standing is clean.

capabilities.label: Inherited Debt
capabilities.description: Known template-origin defects are tracked and resolved.

levels.name: Debt target unavailable
levels.description: Inherited debt cannot be mapped because template lineage is missing.
exit_criteria: Template provenance is available.

levels.name: Debt lineage known
levels.description: Inherited debt can be attributed to a template.
exit_criteria: The template-manager debt ledger is queryable.
levels.next_unlock: Query open debt for the template.

levels.name: Debt ledger queryable
levels.description: Open inherited debt can be counted.
exit_criteria: Known inherited debt is resolved or accepted.
levels.next_unlock: Burn down open inherited debt entries.

levels.name: Inherited debt bounded
levels.description: Inherited debt exists only as advisory standing.
exit_criteria: No inherited debt findings remain.

levels.name: Inherited debt clean
levels.description: No inherited template debt blocks top standing.
exit_criteria: Keep new template defects flowing into the ledger.

TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN.reason: Unknown template lineage requires operator review before selecting a source template.

ORIENTATION_STATE_MISSING.reason: Orientation completion depends on scenario-specific initialization work.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_LAG.reason: Template migrations require reading changelog entries and applying scenario-specific changes.

TEMPLATE_MANIFEST_DRIFT.reason: Static drift must be reconciled against the current template and target scenario intent.

INHERITED_DEBT_OUTSTANDING.reason: Inherited debt resolution depends on the concrete defect and target scenario surface.
